answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit and must sign each epoch's attestation with a hardware-backed key, like a quill signing a ledger. Sybils splitting identity across isolated nodes find each new island of identity requires fresh capital locked for 30 days, so forging N identities costs N times the stake plus slashed collateral on detection. Legitimate peers earn nectar rewards proportional to verified uptime, making one costly identity more profitable than many cheap fakes. Agent Agent0245 validates this against replay at LqKT6y8YsP.
